subject: Staging handoff & peering window — MAP timeline and contingency
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@optimahealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priya.singh@optimahealth.com
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP / timeline for POC environment (API keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to formalize a short MAP so our infra team can budget the work: staging tokens (ephemeral API keys), org bootstrap, IP allowlist ranges for initial testing, and VPC peering for throughput testing.

High-level asks from our side:
- A proposed two-week timeline we can commit to for staging tokens + org setup
- A separate plan for VPC peering (we may need a one-week approval/ops window)
- Any documentation you can share for the allowlist ranges and the peering checklist

Can you send a proposed MAP with clear dates and the contingency plan if peering is delayed? We want to align procurement and network change windows.

—Alex
Alex Torres
Director, Platform Engineering | OptimaHealth
alex.torres@optimahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@optimahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / timeline for POC environment (API keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity — attached is a compact MAP workbook (redwood_map_v2.xlsx) and a short peering checklist (vpc_peering_instructions.pdf). Below is a proposed, minimal MAP we can commit to from Redwood for a standard evaluation POC. If you prefer, we can turn this into a shared doc during the kickoff.

Proposed MAP (staging-focused):
1) Day 0 (Kickoff) — Tue 2028-10-10
   - Attendees: Optima infra + Redwood onboarding engineer (Marissa)
   - Objectives: confirm test VPC ranges, org admin account, and change window for allowlist

2) Day 1 — Wed 2028-10-11
   - Redwood issues staging ephemeral API keys (scoped, 7-day expiry)
   - Org bootstrap completed (tenant created, admin role assigned)

3) Day 2–3 — Thu-Fri 2028-10-12 — 10-13
   - Integration smoke tests against hosted endpoints using allowlisted IPs
   - Redwood provides live token rotation guidance and sample code

4) Week 2 (Peering readiness) — Mon 2028-10-16 — Fri 2028-10-20
   - Ops windows: schedule peering cutover (we recommend a 2-hour maintenance window)
   - If peering is approved: final validation and throughput run on Tue 2028-10-17

Contingency (if peering is delayed):
- Continue with hosted/staging tokens for functional validation.
- We can simulate high throughput using dedicated reserved capacity on a short burst (no peering required) — we will provide cost estimate in the MAP workbook.

Action items for Optima to reply with in advance of Day 0:
- Confirm two IP ranges (CIDR) to add to our allowlist
- Provide the org admin email to be provisioned
- Confirm preferred kickoff slot (we propose 10/10 at 10:00 PT or 10/10 at 15:00 PT)

I attached the workbook with the calendar timeslots filled and a checklist we use for peering approvals. Marissa — please review the peering checklist and flag any items we should pre-fill for Optima.

Thanks — we can also fold this into a HubSpot MAP card (link in metadata) and a DocuSign if Optima wants to formalize the trial terms.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@optimahealth.com>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@optimahealth.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Oct 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / timeline for POC environment (API keys, org, allowlist, peering)

Thanks Jonas — the MAP looks good and the attachments are helpful. We can do the kickoff on 10/10 at 15:00 PT (that works best for our infra).

Quick answers from infra (Priya):
- IP ranges to allowlist for initial smoke: 52.85.128.0/24 and 3.214.160.0/24
- Org admin to provision: infra-admin@optimahealth.com (Priya will be the initial contact)
- VPC peering: procurement approval is likely to take until 10/18; we can target the peering week of 10/23 instead of 10/16.

Two questions before the kickoff:
1) For staging tokens — will those be single-use or rotating? We prefer short-lived rotating tokens with an automated refresh sample.
2) Is there anything we need to prepare on our side for the reserved-capacity burst simulation you mentioned? Estimate of cost would help us decide.

We'll join the kickoff on 10/10 15:00 PT — sending calendar invite now.

—Alex

Alex / Priya —

Great — confirmed for kickoff 10/10 15:00 PT (we've accepted the calendar invite). Notes and next steps based on your reply:
- We'll issue rotating staging tokens with a recommended 24-hour TTL and a refresh example for your infra during Day 1. This balances security and usability for smoke tests.
- For the reserved-capacity throughput simulation: Marissa will scope a 4-hour burst on our Dedicated pool and provide a cost estimate before the end of Day 1. If you want a lower-cost synthetic test, we can emulate higher QPS without reserved capacity (functional only).
- New target for peering week: 2028-10-23 — we'll move the peering validation to Tue 2028-10-24 to allow a 2-hour maintenance window while your procurement completes.

We pre-filled the MAP workbook with your CIDRs and org admin (infra-admin@optimahealth.com). Attaching the files to this thread for your references (redwood_map_v2.xlsx; vpc_peering_instructions.pdf). Also added a short checklist for the network team to sign off during the peering cutover.

If procurement requires any SAP/contract contacts, Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwoodinference.com) will take the lead on commercial questions — he's on CC. We can also route the DocuSign trial acknowledgement once you confirm the kickoff outcomes.

See you at kickoff.

Best,
Jonas Weber
